payload.purpose_context: Mission, Op, pack and Gherkin sections can hold hundreds of children, and today every child lands in every page's sidebar. A configurable cap replaces an oversized group's children with one entry that links to the hub, so the sidebar stays bounded and cheap to build. Slice 1 of the large-hubs epic (#340); the paged hub listing (#342) builds on it.
payload.purpose_tldr: Keep every page's sidebar short when a section has hundreds of child pages.

options: Set sidebar.childCap on the adr section
payload.question: The default cap of 50 would cap this repo's own docs/adr group (81 children). Keep the default and let the ADR group collapse to one entry, or raise the cap for the adr section in docs/_meta/sections.yaml?
How is the capped entry labelled, and is it translatable?

options: Exported pure helper plus shaping that tolerates pre-hidden children; no existing producer wired
Also wire the glossary and gherkin producers
payload.question: What does the sidebar.hidden hint ship as in this slice?

options: 200 small committed markdown files under example/docs
Generated at build time by a script
payload.question: How is the 200-child example hub fixture provided?

payload.final_answer: Set sidebar.childCap: 100 on the adr section; default stays 50
UI string dockitty.sidebar.cappedEntry, default "{count} pages", with a site option that wins
Exported pure helper plus shaping that tolerates pre-hidden children; no existing producer wired
Build-test fixture site generating 200 children at test time; small capped hub in example/; 1,000-child measurement script
